source.title: Les pardons et troménies en Bretagne
source.original_institution: Ministère de la Culture, Inventaire national du patrimoine culturel immatériel
source.original_2017_to_2020_ethnographic_scope: Bretagne historique; localities specified only where reported
source.source_dependency: ONE INVENTORY DOCUMENT DESCRIBES VARIANTS OF RELATED PARDON COMPLEX; NOT N DIFFERENT AUTHOR WITNESSES

method: Direct read of French language HTML inventory sheet sections including procession, fountain blessings, banner ceremonies, historic rites, folk beliefs, civic celebrations, and archaeological history; each action paraphrased with exact displayed web line. Ritual claims not mapped to 1962 authority. Objects and context never automatically promoted to customs.
